assignments.name: is_initial_advocate_assignment
assignments.value: ={{ Boolean(!Boolean($('Fetch Case Directory').first().json.advocate_email) || $('Execute Workflow Trigger').item.json.action === 'initial_assignment' || ($('Execute Workflow Trigger').item.json.advocate_email && $('Execute Workflow Trigger').item.json.advocate_email.toLowerCase().trim() !== ($('Fetch Case Directory').first().json.advocate_email || '').toLowerCase().trim())) }}

assignments.name: has_proceeding_changes
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const existing = $('Fetch Case Directory').first().json || {}; const trig = $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json || {}; const isDeclined = Boolean(trig.action === 'decline' || trig.decline_reason); const isInitial = Boolean(trig.action === 'initial_assignment' || trig.action === 'decline' || existing.case_status === 'pending_onboarding'); if (isInitial || isDeclined) return true; const normalize = (v) => (v || '').toString().trim().toLowerCase(); const stageChanged = Boolean(trig.legal_proceeding_stage && normalize(trig.legal_proceeding_stage) !== normalize(existing.legal_proceeding_stage)); const advocateChanged = Boolean(trig.advocate_email && normalize(trig.advocate_email) !== normalize(existing.advocate_email)); const courtChanged = Boolean(trig.court_name && normalize(trig.court_name) !== normalize(existing.court_name)); const hearingDateChanged = Boolean(trig.hearing_date && (trig.hearing_date || '').toString().trim() !== (existing.hearing_date || '').toString().trim()); const hearingTimeChanged = Boolean(trig.hearing_time && normalize(trig.hearing_time) !== normalize(existing.hearing_time)); const remarksEntered = Boolean(trig.milestone_remarks && normalize(trig.milestone_remarks) !== ''); return stageChanged || advocateChanged || courtChanged || hearingDateChanged || hearingTimeChanged || remarksEntered; })() }}

assignments.name: has_invoice_changes
assignments.value: ={{ Boolean($('Execute Workflow Trigger').item.json.has_invoice_changes === true || $('Execute Workflow Trigger').item.json.has_invoice_changes === 'true') }}

value.matter_title: ={{ $('Format Review Parameters').first().json.document_title || ('Legal Representation - Matter ' + $('Format Review Parameters').first().json.case_id) }}

value.invoice_amount: ={{ $('Format Review Parameters').first().json.invoice_amount !== undefined && $('Format Review Parameters').first().json.invoice_amount !== '' ? Number($('Format Review Parameters').first().json.invoice_amount) : undefined }}

conditions.leftValue: ={{ !$('Format Review Parameters').first().json.is_initial_assignment && Boolean($('Format Review Parameters').first().json.pending_invoice_id) && !['no pending invoice', '', 'none'].includes($('Format Review Parameters').first().json.pending_invoice_id.toLowerCase()) && $('Format Review Parameters').first().json.has_invoice_changes === true }}
